qwen3.5-4b-q4km.name: Qwen3.5 4B

gemma-4-12b-qat.name: Gemma 4 12B (QAT)
gemma-4-12b-qat.summary: Gemma 4 models are designed to deliver frontier-level performance at each size, targeting deployment scenarios from mobile and edge devices (E2B, E4B) to consumer GPUs and workstations (12B, 26B A4B, 31B). They are well-suited for reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding.

granite-4.2-8b-q4km.name: Granite 4.2 8B
granite-4.2-8b-q4km.summary: Granite-4.2-8B is the mid-size reasoning model in the Granite 4.2 family.

gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.name: gpt-oss 20B
gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4.summary: Welcome to the gpt-oss series, OpenAI’s open-weight models designed for powerful reasoning, agentic tasks, and versatile developer use cases.

ministral-3-14b-q4km.name: Ministral 3 14B
ministral-3-14b-q4km.summary: The Ministral 3 family is designed for edge deployment, capable of running on a wide range of hardware.

qwen3.8-27b-udq4km.name: Qwen3.8 27B
qwen3.8-27b-udq4km.summary: Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.8 delivers substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. Qwen3.8-27B brings these advances to a compact, deployment-friendly dense model: a native vision-language model that understands images and videos, with flexible thinking control, designed to carry complex, multi-step tasks through to completion with greater reliability.

gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B (QAT)
gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat.summary: By only activating a 4B subset of parameters during inference, the Mixture-of-Experts model runs much faster than its 26B total might suggest. This makes it an excellent choice for fast inference compared to the dense 31B model since it runs almost as fast as a 4B-parameter model.

granite-4.2-30b-q4km.name: Granite 4.2 30B
granite-4.2-30b-q4km.summary: Granite-4.2-30B is the flagship reasoning model in the Granite 4.2 family.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-q4km.name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B
qwen3.6-35b-a3b-q4km.summary: Built on direct feedback from the community, Qwen3.6 prioritizes stability and real-world utility, offering developers a more intuitive, responsive, and genuinely productive coding experience.
